newsitem.title: JAPAN: Sokaiya hold accounts with Japan 'Big Four' - paper.
newsitem.headline: Sokaiya hold accounts with Japan 'Big Four' - paper.

text.p: Corporate clients linked to a "sokaiya" racketeer named in a recent scandal involving suspected illegal deals at Nomura Securities Co Ltd also have accounts at the rest of Japan's "Big Four" brokerages, a newspaper reported on Friday.

The Mainichi Shimbun report said Japan's securities watchdog found that the corporate clients opened accounts with Daiwa Securities Co Ltd, Nikko Securities Co Ltd and Yamaichi Securities Co Ltd at the same time as they did so at Nomura.
The Securities and Exchange Surveillance Commission (SESC) has been investigating the three brokerages' transactions with the client, Mainichi reported, without identifying sources.
